title: X-Ray export bundle v1
description: Static JSON bundle written by xray_engine.export and read by the web app. Files: manifest.json, portfolio.json, groups/<id>.json, companies/<id>.json, evidence/<id>.json, alerts.json, receipt.json; every file carries `schema` and `kind`, and validates against `#/$defs/<kind>`. Conventions: months are 'YYYY-MM'; every score-point quantity (shown, level, base, contrib, penalty, cap.amount, pillar score, baseline, delta3, sigma, band min, outlook best/common/worst) is an integer number of tenths; weights, shares and confidence are numbers in [0, 1]; money is EUR. Exact identity for every entity-month, in integers: base + sum(pillars[].contrib) - penalty - cap.amount == shown. `band` is derived from `shown` with manifest.bands. Columnar arrays align index by index with the `months` of their own file; null means the entity was not observed that month. Codes (gates, flags, caps, reasons) are open vocabularies explained in manifest.glossary; texts are Spanish. Evidence rows are aggregates, never raw descriptions or single transactions. The companies/ folder is either complete (one file per member listed in the group files) or absent.

bundle_id.description: sha256 over every other file of the bundle, sorted by POSIX relative path: for each file, the path bytes (UTF-8) followed by the file bytes.

generated_at.description: Defaults to the extraction date of the dataset, so identical inputs give identical bytes.

months.description: Scored window: complete months, ascending and contiguous.

pillars.description: Pillar dictionary in contract order: nominal weight and frozen reference median (baseline, tenths).

bands.description: Score bands, ascending by `min` (tenths, inclusive); the first one starts at 0.

glossary.description: Spanish text for every code the bundle uses. A code without entry is shown as is.

groups.description: Sorted by id. Every array has one entry per month; each one is the projection of groups/<id>.json months.

industry.description: Context only; never a score input.

alerts_fired.description: Alerts of the group and its companies dated that month with state fired.

alerts_muted.description: Same, with state suppressed or abstained.

companies.description: Members, sorted by id. `shown` and `band` align with `months` of this file.

truth.description: Treasury reading of the company inside its group, e.g. a swept subsidiary that inherits the group liquidity.

inherits_liquidity.description: True when the liquidity pillar of the last month carries the gate inherited_from_group.

months.description: Ascending; limited to the last months of the entity.

signals.description: What enters the number and with which nominal weight, plus the signals deliberately kept at weight 0 and why.

abstentions.description: Entities abstained on the last month of the window.

checks.description: Label-free validation results. Known keys: isolation, truncation, additivity, scale, determinism, branch_parity, neutrality, persistence, netting_placebo, injection, ablation, rank_stability, history_truncation. Empty when the bundle was exported without a validation run.

bars.description: Optional distribution, e.g. detection delay in months.

entityMonths.description: One entry per scored month of the entity: ascending, inside manifest.months.

entityMonth.description: base + sum(pillars[].contrib) - penalty - cap.amount == shown, in integer tenths.

level.description: Level of the month before display rules; differs from `shown` when the score is carried forward or shrunk.

base.description: Reference score of the coverage branch.

pillars.description: The five pillars in contract order. Unavailable: score null, w_eff 0, contrib 0 and at least one gate.

amount.description: Points removed by the binding cap.

rule.description: Binding cap; null when amount is 0.

fired.description: Every cap rule that holds, strictest first.

branch.description: Available pillar keys joined by '+', contract order; 'none' when empty.

actions.description: Optional. Suggested actions, best uplift first, at most 4; empty on abstained or stale months.

actions_combined.description: Optional. Score with every suggested action applied at once; uplift == new_score - shown.

abstain.description: Not null when the engine abstains: the number is still emitted, alerts are not fired.

unlock.description: What data would lift the abstention.

actions_plan.description: Optional. The stage ladder to the best achievable score.

financing.description: Financing options when management levers are not enough, best uplift first, at most 3; empty otherwise.

outlook.description: Optional. Scenarios best / common / worst of the score horizon_months ahead, computed by the engine from the past of the month alone (truncation-stable): common adds the Theil-Sen drift of the long window to the score when it is measurable (basis 'drift'), else it holds the score (basis 'flat') with a gate that says why; best and worst fan out from common by max(min_delta_points, long_sigma_mult * sigma) points, clamped to 0 and 100. Null on a carried or abstained month.

basis.description: drift: the common scenario projects the measured slope; flat: it holds the score of the month.

horizon_months.description: Months of the projection (six with the reference params).

gates.description: Why the outlook is flat (no_drift, perimeter_shift); open vocabulary, glossary.gates.

w_eff.description: Nominal weight renormalised over the available pillars.

note.description: Sentence built from the aggregate inputs of the pillar.

action.description: One deterministic lever; the uplift is the engine aggregate recomputed over the month with the lever applied, never an estimate.

verdict.description: Past-only trajectory. Not available: direction stable, nature null and a reason.

profile.description: Core card, in the order of the engine profile keys.

coverage.description: 0 when the attribute cannot be inferred.

context.description: Context only: nothing here is an input of pillars or of the aggregate.

seriesList.description: Monthly facts for charts; `values` align with `months` of the same file.

pillar.description: null for facts about the whole entity-month.

period.description: 'YYYY-MM', 'YYYY-MM-DD' or a closed range joined by '..'.

alert.description: id = '<entity_id>:<month>:<kind>'. A fired alert has no suppressed_by; any other state has one.

shown.description: Score of the entity on the alert month.

actions.description: Optional. The suggested actions of that entity-month that attack this alert's cause (title only, at most 2).

financing.description: Optional. The financing instruments of that entity-month that attack this alert's cause (title only, at most 2).

entityId.description: Safe as a file name and as a URL segment.

actionStage.description: One step of the plan ladder: the levers of the stage, the score after them and the cumulative uplift against the shown score.

actionsPlan.description: Optional. The stage ladder to the best achievable score: each stage acts on the month the previous one produced, at most 3 stages.

invoices_due.title: invoices_due.json
invoices_due.description: Top open overdue invoices per company and per group as of the last month, both sides: ar (clients that owe the entity, the work list behind the collect-earlier reminders) and ap (suppliers the entity owes).

reminderSide.description: One side of the overdue invoice lists, per company and per group.

financingRec.description: One financing recommendation: a delta over the measured month, rescored; amount in EUR, null when the instrument moves no money.
